welcome.title: Of all the people I could have met, I'm really happy I met you.
welcome.text: I made a tiny corner of the internet just for you. Take your time and explore all the little secrets hidden here. 💗

memories.title: The Day We Met
memories.description: The moment that changed everything. I remember the exact look on your face and how nervous I was to talk to you. It was the best day of my year.

memories.title: First Photo Together
memories.description: We were both so shy, but look at us now! It's still one of my absolute favorite pictures of us.

memories.title: Funniest Moment
memories.description: I still laugh out loud when I think of this day. You have the most contagious laugh in the world.

memories.title: Favorite Memory
memories.description: Just you, me, and a perfect quiet afternoon. No distractions, just talking and feeling completely at peace with each other.

memories.title: Today
memories.description: Every single day with you is a brand new adventure. I can't wait for all the beautiful memories we have yet to create.

letters.happy: I love seeing that beautiful smile on your face! Never forget how much joy you bring into the world, and especially into my life. Keep shining and sharing your positive energy! 💗
letters.difficult: I wish I could be there to wrap you in a warm hug right now. Take a deep breath. You are incredibly strong, resilient, and you've got this. I believe in you, always. 🌧️💗
letters.motivation: Remember how far you've come and all the things you've achieved! You are smart, capable, and determined. Go show the world what you're made of today! 🌟
letters.laugh: Here is a quick joke for you: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything! 😜 Also, remember that time when we couldn't stop giggling over absolutely nothing? You are my favorite person to laugh with! 😂
letters.miss: I miss talking to you too! Send me a text message right now with a random cute animal emoji, and let's catch up. I'm always here to listen to anything you want to share. 💗
letters.sleep: Close your eyes and think of the calmest, happiest place. Imagine us walking under a starry sky. I'm sending you all the cozy, peaceful vibes. Dream of all the adventures we have ahead. Sleep tight! 🌙

mysteryGift.title: A Special Message
mysteryGift.message: You are the best thing that has ever happened to me. Here is a little collection of love and happy thoughts that I carry with me every day. Thank you for being you!

appreciations: Your endless kindness and how you make everyone feel welcome 💗
The way you make me laugh even when I'm having a stressful day 😂
Your passion and determination to achieve your goals 🌟
The late-night conversations we have about everything and nothing 😭
All the small, quiet memories we've made together 📸

playlist.title: I Think They Call This Love

stars: One thing I admire about you... Your boundless empathy and how deeply you care for everyone around you.
A memory that still makes me smile... The time we got caught in the rain and ended up laughing instead of running.
Something I hope you achieve... All your big dreams in your career, because you deserve it more than anyone.
Something I never want you to forget... That you are loved exactly for who you are, every single day.

secret.message: YOU FOUND THE SECRET HEART! 💖 Here is a secret message: I love you more than words can say. You're my absolute favorite person, my partner-in-crime, and my home.
